title: Posting an assessment
lede: OME normally does this. It is here so you know what gets set for you, and what you cannot change afterwards.

blocks.title: OME posts your exam
blocks.text: Posting happens during the preparation window. Do not post your own exam unless OME has asked you to. If you do, every field below matters.
Posting is what opens the download window. Open the assessment, scroll to the end, and select **Post Assessment**. A dialog opens with these fields.

blocks.caption: Posting fields and the JABSOM convention for each
rows: The exam name as students should see it
This is the label on the student iPad, for download and during the exam.
At least 6 letters plus at least 1 number
Required. The proctor announces it at exam time.
The correct course for the cohort
Drives enrollment and reporting. The wrong course sends the exam to the wrong students.
Students need time to download. JABSOM posts 36 to 48 hours ahead.
30 minutes to 1 hour after the exam
Covers late arrivals and device swaps.
A standing JABSOM rule. Stops a student re-downloading onto a second device.
Appears on the posting and in reporting.
Nudges students before the window closes.
Nudges students to upload after the exam.
Late uploads get flagged, which makes exceptions easy to spot.
Unless your course has planned an in-room review.
JABSOM does not use them for standard pre-clerkship exams.

blocks.title: Max Downloads is always 1
blocks.text: Of everything on this dialog, this is the one hard JABSOM convention rather than a judgment call. It has been 1 in every onboarding document since 2020.

blocks.title: One download freezes the content
blocks.text: Once the assessment is posted and at least one student has downloaded it, questions and answer keys lock. An error found after that becomes a post-exam scoring adjustment instead of an edit. Catch content problems during OME proofing.

blocks.title: The password never goes in an email
blocks.text: Posting usually triggers a general notification so students know the exam is available to download. The password stays out of it. The proctor announces it in the room.
